structuredContent.next_step_markdown:
## Suggested tools for "list domains"

- **`infomaniak_list_domains`** (2 term match): List every domain owned by an Infomaniak organization, with creation and expiration dates.
- **`infomaniak_history`** (1 term match): List the destructive actions taken in the current session, most recent first. Each entry includes whether it can be reversed via infomaniak_undo.
- **`infomaniak_list_organizations`** (1 term match): Lists all Infomaniak organizations (accounts) the current token has technical access to.
- **`infomaniak_list_hostings`** (1 term match): Lists web hostings (classic + Node.js) for a given Infomaniak organization. Use infomaniak_list_organizations first to discover account IDs.
- **`infomaniak_list_sites`** (1 term match): Lists all sites on a given web hosting (with applications attached).

Use `infomaniak_explain` with a tool name to learn its parameters.
